title: Isocline Analysis for a Slope Field
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find the equations of the isoclines for dy/dx = y - x^2 for slopes c = 0, c = 1, and c = -1.

steps.title: Set Differential Expression Equal to Constant c
steps.mathExpression: y - x^2 = c \implies y = x^2 + c
steps.explanation: Isoclines are the level curves of the slope function.

steps.title: Substitute Values of c
steps.mathExpression: c = 0 \implies y = x^2; \quad c = 1 \implies y = x^2 + 1; \quad c = -1 \implies y = x^2 - 1
steps.explanation: A family of vertically shifted parabolas.
